description: A lot of people have lost faith in politics, and that’s really understandable.People are tired of being talked at instead of talked to. They grow weary of hearing promises that sound good during campaign season and disappear once the election is over. They are exhausted from watching leaders fight for attention while families try to afford groceries, pay rent, get their kids safely through school, and care for aging parents.They’ve lost belief that government even tries to work for regular peopl
